faq.a: Rage Room & Axe-Throwing: minimum age 10 years. Anyone under 18 must arrive with a parent or legal guardian who will sign the waiver and stay in the room/lane during the session. Splatter Room: all ages welcome! Kids 12 and under should still have an adult nearby to help with goggles and paint ponchos.

All participants must wear long pants, socks that cover their ankles, and closed-toed, flat shoes only. NO shorts, dresses, skirts, sandals, flip-flops, high heels, or open-toed shoes of any kind will be permitted. Long sleeves and rugged, thick-soled shoes are required. We suggest lightweight, breathable clothing, such as workout attire.

faq.q: What is the refund and rescheduling policy?
faq.a: All Out Smash has a no refund policy. Once you make your appointment, we go to work purchasing items for your experience. You are able to freely reschedule up to 24 hours before your scheduled time.

We accept electronics, un-upholstered furniture, glass, cups, mugs, windows, doors, ceramics, household items, and pretty much anything smashable. We cannot take tube TVs, vacuum cleaners, BBQ grills, upholstered furniture, mattresses, and light bulbs of any kind.

faq.q: What about large groups, birthdays or corporate events?
faq.a: For corporate events, birthday parties, or groups larger than 16 people, please call us at (720) 646-0840. Private lanes and venue buyouts are available for groups and corporate events.
You must remain safe to participate. Staff may pause or stop throwing if anyone appears impaired. The Smash Shack is a full-service bar on site.

faq.q: What if someone in our group doesn't want to throw?
faq.a: No problem. They can cheer you on with food or drinks from the Smash Shack nearby.

faq.q: Do you host axe leagues or tournaments?
faq.a: We do our axe throwing based off of World Axe Throwing League (WATL) but we do not currently do leagues or tournaments.

faq.q: Do I need experience for axe throwing?
faq.a: Nope! Our coaches teach you stance, grip, and scoring games, with a quick safety briefing before throwing.
